step.helpText: Step factor to increment/decrement the value.

locale.helpText: Locale to be used in formatting.

prefix.helpText: Text to display before the value.

suffix.helpText: Text to display after the value.

invalid.helpText: When present, it specifies that the component should have invalid state style.

pattern.helpText: The pattern attribute specifies a regular expression that the element's value is checked against on form submission.

variant.helpText: Specifies the input variant of the component.

children.helpText: Used to get the child elements of the component.

currency.helpText:
The currency to use in currency formatting. Possible values are the [ISO 4217 currency codes](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information/data-standards.html#scrollTo=maintenance-agency), such as "USD" for the US dollar, "EUR" for the euro, or "CNY" for the Chinese RMB.
There is no default value; if the style is "currency", the currency property must be provided.

disabled.helpText: When present, it specifies that the element should be disabled.

readOnly.helpText: When present, it specifies that the element should be read-only.

required.helpText: When present, it specifies that the element must be filled out before submitting the form.

tabIndex.helpText: Index of the element in tabbing order.

unstyled.helpText: When enabled, it removes component related styles in the core.

autoFocus.helpText: When present, it specifies that the component should automatically get focus on load.

ptOptions.helpText: Used to configure passthrough(pt) options of the component.

allowEmpty.helpText: Determines whether the input field is empty.

inputStyle.helpText: Inline style of the input field.

useGrouping.helpText: Whether to use grouping separators, such as thousands separators or thousand/lakh/crore separators.

localeMatcher.helpText: The locale matching algorithm to use. See [Locale Negotation](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl#Locale_negotiation) for details.

ariaLabelledBy.helpText: Establishes relationships between the component and label(s) where its value should be one or more element IDs.

inputClassName.helpText: Inline style of the input field.

tooltipOptions.helpText: Configuration of the tooltip, refer to the tooltip documentation for more information.

currencyDisplay.helpText: How to display the currency in currency formatting. Possible values are "symbol" to use a localized currency symbol such as €, ü"code" to use the ISO currency code, "name" to use a localized currency name such as "dollar"; the default is "symbol".

maxFractionDigits.helpText:
The maximum number of fraction digits to use. Possible values are from 0 to 20; the default for plain number formatting is the larger of minimumFractionDigits and 3;
the default for currency formatting is the larger of minimumFractionDigits and the number of minor unit digits provided by the [ISO 4217 currency code list](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information/data-standards.html#scrollTo=maintenance-agency) (2 if the list doesn't provide that information).

minFractionDigits.helpText:
The minimum number of fraction digits to use. Possible values are from 0 to 20; the default for plain number and percent formatting is 0;
the default for currency formatting is the number of minor unit digits provided by the [ISO 4217 currency code list](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information/data-standards.html#scrollTo=maintenance-agency) (2 if the list doesn't provide that information).
